title: The quality strip: Speed, Metrics, Tests (contract 1.18.0, not stable)
description: Since 1.18.0. `quality` in a3.json (the A3's subject run, under the Gate) and on each forecast of readiness.json. Derived from QualityStrip in src/a3/quality.ts, from kept files only: the forecast's report.json, the monorepo's quality record kept beside it (quality.json) and the harness's weekly mutants (mutants.jsonl). Each light is within reason, look or not measured; a light is within reason only when every check under it was read and in reason. Advisory: never read by a verdict, the Gate, the score or an exit code. Not stable: it may change in a minor release.

lights.description: Speed, Metrics and Tests, in that order.

record.description: The monorepo's quality record the Tests light read; absent when none was kept beside the forecast.

judged.description: true when the record is for the commit side b was built from; false when it is for an earlier one (the newest before it with a record).

ageMs.description: How long before the forecast ran the record was generated.

href.description: The kept quality.json, relative to the site.

evidence.description: The record's own evidence: the Nightly run.

note.description: One sentence for people. Do not parse.

reading.description: The number, in one line. For people.

rule.description: When the light is within reason. For people.

halves.description: Tests only: each half's own state, so a half-measured light says which half.

beside.description: Shown beside the light, never counted (the log differences beside Metrics).
